issue.title: UX pass on CaptureTogglePresentation spoken/notification copy in the running app
issue.description: Proposed by epic bob-cli-1z phase bead bob-cli-1z.5 (note #1). CaptureTogglePresentation's chips, addedLinkText, and removedLinksText byte-match bob-cli's print_human_task_toggle_success by spec, but its statusText, voiceOverAnnouncement, notificationTitle, and notificationBody were an implementing agent's judgment call with no spec'd wording. Now that bob-cli-1z.6 renders the live toggle preview end-to-end, review those four strings in the running Bob Mac Capture app (VoiceOver output and notification center) and adjust any copy that reads poorly in practice. The strings live in Sources/CaptureCore/CaptureTogglePresentation.swift with unit tests in CaptureCoreTests, so a wording change is a tightly bounded edit.

task_type_fields.proposal: Confirm and, where needed, improve the spoken and notification copy (statusText, voiceOverAnnouncement, notificationTitle, notificationBody) that Bob Mac Capture produces for a task toggle, by exercising it in the running macOS app.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-1z spec'd only the human-output-mirroring strings byte-exactly and left the spoken/notification copy to agent judgment; confirming it reads well requires the running macOS app and the owner's ear, neither of which the epic's Linux-hosted agents had, so the epic closed with the copy implemented and unit-tested but unreviewed in practice.
